notes.title: Update. HTC Vive support is live!
notes.notes:
Great news! We are glad to inform you that new version of “STAR BARON” with HTC Vive support is out and ready to play.

[b]What's new:[/b]
[list]
[*]HTC Vive support
[*]Settings menu with vignette on/off and volume options
[*]Bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: VIVE support beta
notes.notes:
If you already have "STAR BARON - VR Beast combat game" in your library you can get access to open beta-test of [b]VIVE[/b] compatible version right now. Follow few simple steps How to activate the beta branch 

[b]NOTE:
You must have ‘STAR BARON - VR Beast combat game ’ added to your Steam library, already![/b]

1) Right click ‘STAR BARON - VR Beast combat game’ and open Properties

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32941842/bb76fbc2dd874eb611f6b3605906fa38817b7960.png[/img]

2) Click on "BETAS" tab

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32941842/bcdbdc8ed8a52069d1c9d6eb82206875ff2cea9b.png[/img]

3) Enter this access code in order to activate beta:

Review4290BeastGame

4) After those steps you will be able to change your Beta participation settings through Steam account settings

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32941842/38d112741fc5f5e8b3df66b25c854f7cd5b727d8.png[/img]

Steam should start downloading this version of the game. Once it has finished, you will be able to try the latest Beta build.
